name: 2027 Option 2 — Quality and distinct learning outcomes
assumptions: Equal weight per need. Full-course assessment evidence; course completion is not competency sign-off. Budgets exclude internal practice. Shared learning is inherited once. Planning year 2027. Curated proposal, not an optimisation claim. Original v8 scores unchanged. Full-course study times; TR-118 full RMF/Playbook/Profile bundle has an open-ended 4h+ duration, so 6h is a labelled planner estimate subject to pilot. Internal hours are learner estimates and do not increase assessed coverage. Primary Practitioner labs need basic Python or coached support. Quality means syllabus/assessment evidence and role fit, not proven learner effectiveness. Full-catalogue access remains available; recommendation exclusions enforce this shortlist until a head changes them. Planning duration corrections: TR-158 1h30 means 1.5h; TR-155 official four-module path totals 9h26m (566/60 hours), superseding the catalogue 8h metadata for planning only. TR-159 combines several lab collections and has no total duration, so exclude from auto-selection until scoped. These do not alter assessment scores. Explicit minute durations for INT-271, INT-275, INT-276, INT-340, INT-452, INT-476 and INT-1473 are retained using overrides because the app parser currently treats their parenthesised lecture counts as ambiguous; no content-based score changes. MCP server construction is an Expert addition. Broad all-Practitioner core is Evaluating AI Agents plus CSA agentic controls, with bank Skill/connector practice. Generic governance, guardrail and coding-awareness supplements are optional rather than mandatory where they add no scored need coverage. V9 corporate-scope revision, 16 October 2026: TR-127 has been removed from the catalogue at the project owner’s request. Personal-assistant workstation warnings are not a required curriculum component. Other course scores are unchanged. The previous Option 4 is withdrawn because its remaining selections are identical to Option 2.
